== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ブリザード1</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2名のパイロットと8名の乗客を搭乗させられる。対：損耗＜4。「AT-ATレーザー砲」を使用して「目標、メイン・ジェネレーター」を試みる際、合計値に1を加える。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ヴィアーズ将軍のAT-AT。<u>密閉型</u>。高度な通信装置を内蔵。実験的な照準システムを搭載している。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Blizzard 1</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>General Veers' AT-AT. Enclosed. Has advanced communications equipment built in. Equipped with an experimental targeting system.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>Can carry 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. When using an AT-AT Laser Cannon to attempt Target The Main Generator, add 1 to the total.</blockquote>

The Japanese names the weapon AT-ATレーザー砲 (“AT-AT Laser Cannon”), where the original English names [[AT-AT Cannon]]. It says “attempt” 目標、メイン・ジェネレーター (“Target The Main Generator”). Both original faces state the 2-pilot and 8-passenger capacity, immunity to attrition below 4 and +1 to the total. Neither original face includes the later “Landspeed may not be increased” sentence found on [[Blizzard 1 (Errata)]].<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Hoth-D-blizzard1-decipher-archive.gif|Original English card face]].</ref>

== Rules ==
The November 1998 [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] states that English is the standard for tournament play, directing foreign-language cards and rules to be played and interpreted as their English counterparts under current rulings, errata and clarifications.<ref name="foreign-language-rule">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 62, Foreign-language cards and rules.</ref>
